editorial.text: We’re often, it seems to me, behind other countries at the moment in terms of initiatives and programmes in libraries but there’s one thing which I have been aware of for years in the UK which is way and above what I have seen elsewhere. This is the Get It Loud in Libraries phenomenon that brings some pretty darn good music to local libraries. I finally caught up with one of the prime movers of this, Stewart Parsons, a couple of weeks ago and we got to talking. While chatting – it was at a libraries conference – the manager of Skelmersdale Library came up to us and told Stewart that the gig he had put on in her library the week before was the best thing that had happened in her career. Now that shows what a great impact this programme can have, and it’s not a one-off because I see stellar feedback from Get It Loud all the time on Twitter. So, of course, I asked Stewart to write a piece for PLN and I am very pleased that he agreed. Please find it below and, um … rock on.
